review_scope: repository source, security-boundary and evidence review
review_method: direct source review with a separate revalidation pass for the bounded federation remediation

limitations: This repository review is not an external security audit.
Application-specific target applications retain their normal OS privileges.
areas.observation: No additional authorization bypass found in the reviewed routes. The review traced owner binding, deny precedence, confirmation separation, post-confirmation revalidation, attempt consumption and reconciliation permits.
areas.title: Authorization and confirmation

limitations: Same-UID hostile processes outside Semwright remain a documented non-claim.
Interactive Windows behavior remains a separate R18 gate.
areas.observation: Session/request limits, peer authentication and cancellation ownership were directly reviewed. Same-UID malicious processes remain explicitly outside the Unix IPC threat boundary.
areas.title: IPC and session identity

limitations: Correctness still depends on each backend's validate/is_focused implementation and platform evidence.
areas.observation: The dispatch path revalidates stale identity and focus after policy/approval. No implicit input fallback was found.
areas.title: Object identity and focus

limitations: No new physical portal consent sessions were created for this source review.
Physical desktop/mixed-display residuals remain R06, not a source-review failure.
areas.observation: Source review found owner binding, revocation checks, separate ScreenCast/RemoteDesktop authority and single-use restore-token behavior. Historical isolated portal evidence remains environment-scoped.
areas.title: Portal authority

limitations: Configured roots still assume an owner-controlled setup boundary.
Blender/application-native file APIs cannot inherit the broker's FD-relative guarantees.
areas.observation: Direct source review confirmed three platform-specific mechanisms remain distinct rather than weakened to a portable lowest common denominator.
areas.title: Filesystem confinement

limitations: Linux Bubblewrap/Landlock regressions are not a formal kernel proof.
The federation remediation received a separate revalidation pass; this is not an external organizational audit.
areas.observation: Host-tool parent binding and persistent session lifecycle were directly reviewed, including cleanup after lost parent/transport. No new escape route was found in the reviewed source.
areas.title: Driver and Plugin isolation

limitations: The product fix received a separate revalidation pass; that receipt is recorded and passed.
Hosted current-source federation regressions passed, but they do not replace broader platform/release certification.
areas.observation: A resource-lifecycle defect was confirmed: rmcp 3.4.1 list_all_tools accumulated pages without an item/page/cursor-cycle bound and Semwright checked 512 only afterward. Commit 4ef9a06e486cd8d2e3851c298e244435ecef3232 replaces it with Semwright-owned bounded pagination and synthetic oversize/cursor-cycle regressions.
areas.title: Federated MCP

limitations: A separately granted unrestricted shell/desktop tool can bypass this mediated surface.
The target application itself may process hostile content with its own privileges.
areas.observation: No text-to-authority path was found in the reviewed federation/Skills/broker routes. The project correctly avoids claiming universal LLM prompt-injection immunity.
areas.title: Prompt-injection containment

limitations: Hash chaining is not tamper-proof against a malicious same-UID process.
Documentation fixes are not an external security attestation.
areas.observation: Disclosure paths were directly reviewed. Earlier documentation/reporting mismatches were remediated during the review; adoption remains separately reviewable.
areas.title: Audit and disclosure

limitations: Separate revalidation is complete for the bounded pagination remediation.
Hosted regression success does not prove absence of all resource exhaustion paths.
areas.observation: One new resource-lifecycle defect was found. The source fix adds incremental bounded pagination; other inspected job/session paths were already bounded and fail closed.
areas.title: Resources and lifecycle

limitations: Open Dependabot update PRs remain maintainer work and were not merged by R.
Current dependency/fuzz/coverage jobs may legitimately skip when their source area is unaffected; skips are not PASS evidence.
areas.observation: The review scanned all workflow uses entries in the candidate and found zero unpinned external Actions. Release admission currently exits 2 because live_desktop_matrix and security_review remain false.
areas.title: Supply chain

limitations: Physical Hyprland/mixed-display coverage remains external to this source review.
Unlocked Windows interactive certification remains external to this source review.
Authorized live macOS TCC acceptance remains separate from hosted build evidence.
areas.observation: Direct source review found explicit platform-specific fail-closed behavior. Documentation now describes Windows as implemented/native-tested but not interactively certified and macOS arbitrary driver/plugin execution as unavailable.
areas.title: Platform boundaries

limitations: R16 closure is repository-scoped and is not an external organizational security audit.
Physical desktop and unlocked Windows certification remain separate environment-dependent release gates.
A passing source review does not by itself authorize a release.
governance_note: R-009 remains open in FINDINGS.json; current repository settings were rechecked on 2026-10-04.
